podcast.title: Commercial Jingles Writer
podcast.body: Before his folk singing career and "Dazed and Confused," Jake Holmes became a writer of commercial jingles, notably for the US Army's "Be All You Can Be" campaign and Dr. Pepper. "He's not a blues singer, but a writer of commercial jingles. Remember the US Army's Be All You Can Be? We do more before 9am than most people do all day."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Jimmy Page Hearing "Dazed and Confused"
xref.body: While Jimmy Page was a member of The Yardbirds, he heard Jake Holmes perform his song "Dazed and Confused" in 1968, which he later reworked for Led Zeppelin, leading to a plagiarism dispute. "Jimmy Page heard that version when he was still with the Artbirds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
